fk-2ull.title: Landscape: open plains, yellowish grass
fk-2ull.summary: Open plains with slightly yellow grass. The ocean is not clearly visible here.

fk-6TmE.title: Coverage: few Gen 3 trekkers, remote isles
fk-6TmE.summary: A British overseas territory east of southern Argentina, counted as the UK for streaks. There are only a couple of older Gen 3 trekkers on three western islands, none on roads, so just memorise them.

fk-CyBk.title: Coverage: boat trekker, ship in bay
fk-CyBk.summary: A boat trekker in a bay, with yellow hills in the distance and an expedition cruise ship in the bay.

fk-Kg1F.title: Landscape: sandy beach, red and blue jackets
fk-Kg1F.summary: A sandy beach with other people in red and blue jackets.

fk-YLmC.title: Landscape: open plains, ocean, rocky ground
fk-YLmC.summary: The trekker crosses open plains with the ocean clearly visible, and the ground sometimes gets rocky. Do not confuse it with the Faroe Islands trekker.

fk-oIoA.title: Landscape: dark brown soil, tire tracks
fk-oIoA.summary: Inland, the soil is dark brown and tire tracks may be visible.
